candidate_selection_grid.selection_policy: rank by train/validation-only score; locked-OOS hidden until candidate freeze

deployable_success_reason: strict zero-liquidation lane passed OOS return, MDD, Sharpe/Sortino/smart Sortino/Calmar gates; return/MDD is diagnostic-only

funding_cost_sensitivity.conservative_drag_model: funding is treated as a same-direction cost drag for both longs and shorts

strict_zero_liquidation_lane.promotion_rule: train/validation/locked-OOS liquidation_count must be zero, every split minimum margin buffer must be positive, OOS MDD must stay within 25%, OOS return must beat the current-base reference, and Sharpe/Sortino/smart Sortino/Calmar must be positive. Return/MDD is diagnostic report-only, not a promotion hurdle.
